description: Answers a plain-English question about the net asset value of a listed mining company covered by Harcourt Valuations: what it is worth, its NAV per share, its price to NAV, how its valuation moves with the gold, silver, copper or uranium price, or which companies Harcourt covers. Harcourt builds NAV models asset by asset from each company's own filed technical reports (NI 43-101, S-K 1300, JORC). Answers are written by Klondike Mike, Harcourt's assistant, from Harcourt's published figures, and are not investment advice. Takes one question naming the company. Rate limited per caller per day.

question.description: The question, in plain English, naming the company. For example: "What is Seabridge Gold worth at today's gold price?"

name: ask_mike
title: Ask Klondike Mike about a mining company
